summary: Tested new forgot-password / reset-password flow end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (enumeration safety, no active reset, short password 422, expired code, wrong-then-correct code + login with new password). Frontend: /signin -> forgot-password-link -> /forgot-password step 1 -> step 2 -> mismatch validation -> fp-back navigation all pass. Maria's password restored to Patient2026! (verified 200 login).

tests_executed.backend_pytest: 5/5 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset.py (TestForgotPasswordEnumeration, TestResetPasswordFlows: no_active_reset_400, short_password_422, expired_400, wrong_then_correct_then_login_and_old_pwd_rejected)
tests_executed.frontend_ui: PASS - forgot-password-link on /signin -> /forgot-password; fp-identifier/fp-request advance to step 2 with generic success toast; fp-code/fp-new/fp-confirm/fp-submit rendered; mismatched new/confirm shows 'Passwords do not match' toast; fp-back from step 2 -> step 1, from step 1 -> /signin
tests_executed.enumeration_safety: PASS - POST /api/auth/forgot-password {identifier:'nobody@nowhere.com'} returns 200 with generic 'If an account matches...' message
tests_executed.regression_login: PASS - maria.lopez@demo.com/Patient2026! -> 200 with role=patient after test cleanup (verified via curl)

critical_code_review_comments: reset-password: when user is not found (invalid identifier), returns 400 'Invalid or expired code.' which is enumeration-safe (good). Confirmed matches design intent.

forgot-password bubbles up 502 from email provider when the recipient domain is unroutable (e.g. @demo.com). This leaks the fact that an account exists for that identifier (unknown ids get generic 200, known @demo.com ids get 502). Consider swallowing provider errors and returning the same generic 200 to preserve full enumeration safety, and logging the failure server-side only.
ForgotPassword.jsx step-1 identifier is not trimmed for the client-side match but backend trims — OK. minLength on fp-new is enforced client-side + server-side (422) — good.
No rate limiting on /auth/forgot-password observed — could be abused to spam email provider. Consider per-IP/per-identifier throttle.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Maria's password was temporarily set to MariaNew2026! during the happy-path test and restored to Patient2026! via module-scoped fixture; verified with a post-teardown login call (200).
seed_data_creation: Seeded password_resets docs (bcrypt-hashed codes) for maria.lopez@demo.com during tests; every test deletes/updates the doc as needed and final teardown removes it.
